detailed_description:
The target video is a photorealistic live-action portrait in soft natural daylight.
[Shot 1] A static shot frames <Subject 1> from the chest up, centered and facing the camera directly, as in a portrait photograph. She wears a plain white T-shirt. Soft afternoon light falls evenly on her face through green leaves, and the park behind her is gently out of focus. Her expression is calm with a faint natural smile; she holds still and looks straight into the lens, blinking once. Realistic skin texture with visible pores and fine facial hair, natural colors, sharp focus on the eyes, no retouching, no text anywhere in the frame.

overall_soundscape: Quiet outdoor ambience with faint birdsong.
